I've been using this planner from ForLittleLion since 2024 and it's been the perfect thing to organize my life.  I've used every method of personal organization, from digital to do lists to online calendars and journals, but this by far has been the best overall solution.  I keep track of my schedule, especially helpful with the links to my enter appointments to my calendar app, as well as write notes to myself as a way to keep records for things that I've done.  I highly recommend online planners as a whole and this one in particular as a wonderful way to corral all the details of your life.

I bought this and another planner from the seller "Smooth Planners" - it turned out they are both exactly the same planner. Because of this, I'm dubious that this seller created the content themselves - maybe they're running two Etsy storefronts? The way they have you download these planners is also exceptionally confusing - you have to select the options you want, then the planner is generated once you've selected the options you want. You can't download all of the files you've purchased at once. I expected to be able to do so, it's disappointing that I have to individually generate each type of planner. I'm glad I only paid $3.00 each for the planners, so it's not worth a refund to me.
